name: Molio KB
description: Connect to the local Molio knowledge base: browse files, full-text search, and AI Q&A grounded in your own notes.
description_zh: 连接本机 Molio 知识库：浏览文件树、全文搜索、读取原文，并基于你自己的积累做 AI 问答。全部只读，不修改知识库。
description_en: Connect to the local Molio knowledge base: browse the file tree, full-text search, read documents, and ask AI questions grounded in your own notes. Read-only by design.
examples_zh: 在我的知识库里搜一下「分布式事务」
看看我的知识库都有哪些文件
基于我的知识库总结一下今年的项目复盘
把知识库里 notes/2026 目录下的会议纪要读给我听
examples_en: Search my knowledge base for 'distributed transactions'
Show me what files are in my knowledge base
Summarize this year's project retrospectives from my knowledge base
Read me the meeting notes under notes/2026 in my knowledge base
